svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-aviator-shirt-male-epaulet-sleeve-officer","name":"Men's Aviator Shirt Uniform adult officer epaulet sleeves (overlay, registered to garment-aviator-shirt-male; blank grade)","size_in":{"w":27.4508,"h":28.4792},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2745.08,2847.92],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The slide-on epaulet sleeve as it lies on the shirt's strap: the strap's edge-on band (0.46 in thick, LIVE10-ART 2; the strap itself is 0.9 in wide), one axis from the armhole seam to the collar end, cut square across 0.5 in + the button + 0.06 in short of the strap's point so the button shows; same outer end, same two long edges, upper edge the shoulder line, so it covers the strap and nothing else (Fig 4.16: the gray sleeve is as wide as the strap, 0.88-0.94 in at the pocket's 5.25 in). The top-down view is the separate asset garment-aviator-epaulet-top-*. Colours are those of the top-down sleeve assets (rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-* #5f5c5c, measured on CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1; cadet officers the family grade-cloth blue #142347, assets/epaulet-sleeve-colours.js), as the Class B sleeves, so the strip on the shirt and the view from above show one sleeve; the regulation gives no shade or dimension.","anchors":{"top_center":[1372.54,0],"bottom_center":[1372.54,2847.92],"center":[1372.54,1423.96],"left_edge":[0,1423.96],"right_edge":[2745.08,1423.96],"rank_slot_right_center":[633.38,321.94],"rank_slot_left_center":[2111.69,321.94],"rank_rule_point_right":[454.36,390.4],"rank_rule_point_left":[2290.72,390.4]},"landmarks":{"epaulet_sleeve_right":{"x":391.28,"y":210.43,"w":484.21,"h":225.13},"rank_slot_right":{"x":391.28,"y":210.43,"w":484.21,"h":225.13},"epaulet_sleeve_poly_right":[[391.28,389.9],[453.77,358.22],[858.83,210.43],[875.49,253.98],[400.67,435.55]],"epaulet_sleeve_left":{"x":1869.59,"y":210.43,"w":484.21,"h":225.13},"rank_slot_left":{"x":1869.59,"y":210.43,"w":484.21,"h":225.13},"epaulet_sleeve_poly_left":[[2353.8,389.9],[2291.31,358.22],[1886.24,210.43],[1869.59,253.98],[2344.41,435.55]]},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-aviator-shirt-male","documented":["gray epaulet sleeves, embroidered grade (CAPR 39-1 4.2.5.1.1.1 / 4.2.6.2.1)","grade insignia centred 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 36-2903 4.5.1.1.1)"],"assumed":["sleeve length (ends short of the strap button)","grade not drawn: placed by the rank insignia assets at rank_slot (centre of the sleeve, on the strap axis)"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
